ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white and light-grey pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted against a narrow perimeter of low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous white region across the central fluke body. A continuous, irregular dark-intensity band follows the trailing edge. Small, discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (spots) are mapped in the upper-left interior and center-right interior of the white pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 145 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration profile with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels; most significant jagged irregularities are concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a broad concave curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) are prominent at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected on the left lobe, trending diagonally from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge, particularly on the right lobe distal section. Permanent barnacle encrustation clusters at tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, low-intensity annular (ring-like) pixel formation is located immediately to the right of the median notch on the white ventral surface.
